Job Title: Java Developer - Entry Level

Location: Jersey City, NJ
Job Type: Full-time
Work Authorization: Visa Independent Only

Job Description:
• Develop and maintain Java applications with a focus on backend services.
• Collaborate with senior developers to design efficient systems.
• Write unit tests and integrate them with existing systems.
• Work with RESTful APIs to exchange data between services.
• Debug and fix issues within the Java applications.
• Participate in team meetings to review project progress and challenges.

Company DescriptionMagnus Technology Solutions provide quick orientation / training for professionals & placement for candidates having work authorization in USA.
